title: [Feature Request] Additional values for local web server
body:
I would like to be able to have access to more values on the local api. Would it be possible to integrate things like:

-   glucosetarget values like 80-180 _(the same I have used in xDrip of course)_ 
-  glucoseprediction

Or is it already possible to get access to it? I checked API Endpoints I found in the [local web service docs](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/Documentation/technical/Local_Web_Services.md)

I think the [Nightscout Endpoint](http://127.0.0.1:17580/status.json) will only return values if a running Nightscout is connected.

> @Navid200 this is a valid feature request and not a question which can be answered from supporters.

We are asking the user community to help us by spending some time doing their own research before opening an issue.
When the first post contains a question like "Or is it already possible to get access to it", it could be taken that the possibility may exist and the user doesn't know. 

So, you know that this capability does not exist?  Would you please answer the question then?
Also, would you please have the first post edited to reflect that?
We cannot expect the developers to read every single post in every one of the 300 open issues to decide which one they should focus on next, can we?
@FreDiabetics It looks like your are a developer and using the API. Maybe, you can provide a pull request?
